effects.name: Tesseract Idol
effects.description: Compresses the character onto three luminous faces of an impossible floating cube.

effects.name: Voxel Reconstruction
effects.description: Rebuilds the character as animated illuminated cubes that separate in depth.

effects.name: Dimensional Fold
effects.description: Folds the sprite through a rotating impossible kaleidoscope centered inside the body.

effects.name: Chromatic Soul Echo
effects.description: Pulls several colored copies of the character out of alignment like separated souls.

effects.name: Reality Shredder
effects.description: Cuts the sprite into independently displaced strips with violent RGB fractures.

effects.name: Impossible Melt
effects.description: Turns the lower body into living vertical trails while the face swims out of phase.
